# C02 — OpenZeppelin NativeShieldedToken (kind 1): deploy, mint, publish

<!-- Generated by deployments/stagenet/tools/prepare-cases.ts from the examples' metadata.json and the vectors; do not edit. -->

**Demonstrates**: color = tokenType(domainSep, contract) = the color of the shielded coin minted to wallet 1.

**Expected conclusion** (from the reference reducer, before any transaction): 1 visible kind-1 identity ("Acme Shield", "ASHD", 6) with a color equal to the minted coin color.

## Steps (Stagenet)

Values filled in by S5 when it runs: the records (`record.json`), observations (`observed-*.json`, `wallet-status.json`) and the transaction table below. Shell set-up (bash or zsh; S5 plan §S5a; the secret directory is mounted read-only into the signer container only):

```sh
signer() {
  MIP0018_SECRET_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/mips/00013-mip-0018-reference/private" \
  MIP0018_STATE_DIR="<0700 state directory outside the repository>" \
  MIP0018_DOCKER_NETWORK="<network of the two proof servers>" \
  MIP0018_DOCKER_ENV="-e MIP0018_PROOF_SERVER_URL=<proof-server 9.0.0-rc.8 URL> -e MIP0018_WALLET_PROOF_SERVER_URL=<proof-server 9.0.0-rc.6 URL>" \
  docker/signer.sh mip0018 -- "$@"
}
wallet_free() { docker/run.sh mip0018 -- "$@"; }
```

| # | Step | Wallet | Exit | Command |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `deploy` | wallet1 | 0 | `signer deploy --network stagenet --mnemonic-file /run/mip0018/secrets/stagenet-wallet.mnemonic --wallet-cache /run/mip0018/state/wallet1.cache --example native-shielded --record deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/record.json` |
| 2 | `mint` | wallet1 | 0 | `signer call --network stagenet --mnemonic-file /run/mip0018/secrets/stagenet-wallet.mnemonic --wallet-cache /run/mip0018/state/wallet1.cache --record deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/record.json --circuit mint --args '[{"bytes":{"$signer":"coinPublicKey"}},"1000000",{"$random":32}]' --step mint` |
| 3 | `publish` | wallet1 | 0 | `signer publish --network stagenet --mnemonic-file /run/mip0018/secrets/stagenet-wallet.mnemonic --wallet-cache /run/mip0018/state/wallet1.cache --record deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/record.json --circuit publishMetadata --step publish` |
| 4 | `verify-publish` | none | 0 | `wallet_free verify --network stagenet --record deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/record.json --step publish --expect @deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/expect/publish.json --wait 120` |
| 5 | `list` | none | 0 | `wallet_free list --network stagenet --record deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/record.json --expect @deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/expected.json --json > deployments/stagenet/cases/C02/observed-list.json` |
